name: Switchgrid
description: An intermediary that collects a customer's consent on its own page and relays the meter data of the operators it serves (load curves, indexes, technical data, as the operator's raw files). Read by @nexgen-os/switchgrid under the customer's mandate; what it gives is kept as long as that consent holds, and erased when it is withdrawn.
